tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Find spectacles worldwide (festivals, parades, light and drone shows, eccentric traditions) by trip dates, place, type and size. Returns up to `limit` events, soonest first (or nearest first when near_lat/near_lng are given), each with dates, status, place, type, size, description, official website

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Full details of one spectacle by its id (from search_events): dates, status, place and coordinates, official website, the quoted source of its dates and when it was last checked.

tools.name: list_filters
tools.description: The types, sizes, regions and countries in the guide, with how many spectacles each has, and how many are venues and shows open all year (the year_round option of search_events).
